name: Do I need a permit for backyard drainage work in Henderson?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for backyard drainage work in Henderson?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need a permit for backyard drainage work in Henderson depends on the scope and nature of the project. Minor landscaping changes or small surface drains typically don't require one. However, extensive excavation, significant regrading that alters property lines, or projects involving connection to municipal storm drains usually do. It's always best to consult with your contractor or the City of Henderson's building department to confirm specific permit requirements for your planned work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit requirements in Henderson depend on project scope; extensive excavation or connections to municipal systems often require one. Check with the city.
